promise: Blade, with Mahershala Ali, comes November 3, 2023 (as announced at San Diego Comic-Con).
description: Feige's SDCC 2022 slate put Blade in theaters November 3, 2023. The film was pushed to September 2024, then removed from the calendar entirely amid director and writer turnover; as of 2026 no Blade film has been released.
evidence: Film pulled from 2024 schedule; multiple directors left; no release as of mid-2026
sources: Marvel Studios SDCC 2022 panel coverage, Variety
Variety / The Hollywood Reporter delay reports 2023-2025

promise: The UK would host the world's first global AI Safety Summit and secure international agreement on frontier AI risks
description: Sunak promised the UK would lead global AI safety governance and deliver the first international agreement on frontier AI at Bletchley Park. The summit ran Nov 1-2, 2023 as billed and produced the Bletchley Declaration, signed by 28 countries including the US and China, plus the launch of the UK AI Safety Institute.
evidence: AI Safety Summit held at Bletchley Park Nov 1-2, 2023 (Wikipedia: AI Safety Summit)
UK AI Safety Institute launched at the summit (Nov 2, 2023); Sunak's Musk on-stage interview
